about_the_game:
With EVOLVE Advanced we're catering to your tastes as a hardcore enthusiast!

Do you find yourself repeatedly running EVOLVE to measure through some things, for example during an overclock, or when writing articles? Then EVOLVE Advanced is for you!

We've provided in this version a lot of automation control that helps you excel at the tasks you're doing. EVOLVE Advanced lets you run EVOLVE without clicking through our user interface, by specifying all the options for a run on the commandline. It can also output reports of different types as .csv files, both categorized scores as the final output, as well as intermediate frame times of all the frames that are run. EVOLVE Advanced lets you do official runs from the commandline as well as custom runs that suit your testing significantly more accurate.

On the commandline you can specify resolution, render resolution scale, the rendering mode (path tracing vs ray tracing), inline vs pipeline vs work graph and we let you specify all the graphics presets!

Additionally, if you find yourself doing burn-in or battery testing - you can enable our benchmark looping configurations to just keep running EVOLVE on repeat.

Please check terms of use for when/how to use EVOLVE in a professional environment.
